## Exercise

### Multiple Choice Questions

1. $Z$ is an element with its 111 protons and mass number 252. Which is the most appropriate expression for the atom?

a. $^{111}\text{Z}$

b. $^{111}_{252}\text{Z}$

c. $^{252}\text{Z}$

d. $^{252}_{111}\text{Z}$

2. What is the relative atomic mass of the element $X$? (Here, $X$ is just a symbol, not an element)

| Isotope | Percentage of Availability |
| --- | --- |
| $^{146}\text{X}$ | 25 |
| $^{154}\text{X}$ | 75 |

a. $148$

b. $150$

c. $152$

d. $153$

3. If the real mass of an element is $4.482 \times 10^{-23}$ then its relative atomic mass will be-

a. $25$

b. $40$

c. $29$

d. $27$

4. The formula $^{27}_{13}\text{Al}$ shows that the element has

i. proton number $13$

ii. mass number $27$

iii. electron number $10$

Which of the below is correct?

a. i and ii

b. ii and iii

c. i and iii

d. i, ii and iii

5. What is the atomic number of Potassium?

a. $15$

b. $17$

c. $19$

d. $21$
